Notice
This advertisement is for market research. This advertisement is not a solicitation for offers, nor is it a request for proposals. The purpose of this advertisement is to identify potential sources and suitable locations and is not intended to pre-qualify or disqualify any potential offers. The Government will not pay for any costs incurred as a result of this advertisement. The Government cannot provide any warranty, expressed or implied, as to the accuracy, reliability or completeness of contents of the furnished information found within this advertisement; Government is under no responsibility to respond to any inquiries under this advertisement. Respondents are advised that the Government assumes no responsibility to award a lease based upon responses to this advertisement.

Description
The VA seeks to lease approximately 12,529 RSF of medical space with a minimum of 70 parking spaces within the delineated area explained below for use as Clinical space. VA will first consider leased space located in an existing building, then build to suits.
Lease term will be for 10 years, lease extensions will be negotiated separately and are not guaranteed.

See attached PDF for full description.
